description: Littlecourt is barely born before he asks his mother for his brothers’ old clothes and a bundle of food and sets off into the world. Before he’s a day old, he has a sword that can beat a whole army, a ship that fits in his pocket, and a knack for brewing.
summary: Newborn Littlecourt kills three trolls while Sir Red hides up a tree and takes the credit, then brings the King’s other daughter up from the bottom of the sea.
